display.purpose: The name or project title, once per page.

label.purpose: Dates, versions, paths, tools: data only.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: A picked stack plate rising 8px; off with prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Entry row
components.description: A CV entry head line under a 1px rule; only the head inverts on hover.
components.html: Contributeur étudiant, La Forgedepuis févr. 2026
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 2px 24px; padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px solid #1c1b19; font: 600 16px/1.4 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1b19; } .ds-row-meta { font: 400 13px 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-row:hover { background: #1c1b19; color: #fbfaf8; padding-inline: 6px; }

components.name: Link
components.description: Bold text-coloured link; a 2px underline appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #1c1b19; font: 600 16px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b19; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Display name
components.description: The one loud element of a page.
components.css: .ds-display { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(44px, 8.4vw, 74px)/0.84 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.06em; color: #1c1b19; }

narrative.overview: The site reads like a good repository README hung on a museum wall: one column of plain facts, set in black on paper, with the owner's name as the only loud object. The museum treatment gives it its rawness: a huge, tight grotesk name, 1px graphite rules between entries, and states shown by inverting a whole block to black instead of by colour.
keyCharacteristics: One huge name, everything else at reading size.
Graphite on paper, no hue anywhere.
1px rules and full-block inversion instead of cards, shadows or tints.
Mono only for values: dates, versions, paths, tool names.

rules.name: The No Hue Rule
rules.body: No colour other than the neutrals. Status, emphasis and selection are shown by weight, size or inversion, never by a coloured accent.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: A selected or hovered entry inverts as a whole block. Never tint a block partially.

rules.name: The One Shout Rule
rules.body: Display size appears once per page.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Mono only for values a reader could copy.

rules.name: The One Object Rule
rules.body: Depth belongs to the stack alone. Any other element that needs emphasis inverts; it never rises.

dos: Do set the name and project titles in Display, once per page.
Do separate entries with 1px graphite rules and invert the hovered entry as a whole block.
Do keep every corner square and every line 1px.
Do design the dark theme with the same care.
donts: Don't add any hue, including blue for links.
Don't use drop shadows, offset shadows, thick borders or rounded cards.
Don't set labels or headings in mono or uppercase-tracked mono.
